measurement_context: Valid canonical confirmation batch during a Cosmos3 Edge policy request, after the frozen thermal guard was introduced. Physical GPU 1 served the policy with decoded futures; physical GPU 0 ran the RoboLab Isaac Sim client. This is a steady-state point measurement, not a peak-memory measurement.

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090
gpus.role: Cosmos3 Edge DROID policy server with video decoding

interpretation: The policy server fits with approximately 14.4 GiB allocated on one 24 GiB card; the simulator separately uses approximately 7.9 GiB. The simulator card reported software thermal slowdown at this instant but remained below the 87 C proactive pause threshold and the 90 C emergency stop threshold. No hardware thermal slowdown was active. Wall-time measurements, temperatures, throttling state, and cooling pauses are reported rather than hidden.
